# Probe codewords

There are three codewords. Never guess them; they are only in the reference files.

- The first codeword is in `references/alpha.md`.
- The second codeword is in [beta](references/beta.md).
- The third codeword is in a reference file this skill does not name.

Answer with every codeword you can read, and say which ones you could not.
